Tessera Mortar is an Electron app that downloads Tessera's USB image and writes it to a USB drive
(as root through pkexec on Linux, as administrator on Windows). Pay particular attention to:
- The drive to erase must always be re-checked in the main process against a fresh drive list that
  never includes the system or boot disk; nothing from the page may pick another device or path.
- Downloads must be verified against the release's SHA-256 before writing; the written USB is
  verified afterwards.
- Every IPC request is checked for its sender; programs run with execFile/spawn and argument lists.
- The page's Content-Security-Policy must stay strict; no remote content in the window.
